narration:1:1760004001:0.text: After bidding farewell to Lyca and Bryon, you travel through the night toward the Ashen Wastes...
narration:1:1760004001:0.source_cn: 告别了莱卡与布莱恩，你们连夜赶往荒角沙漠……
narration:1:1760004001:0.male: After bidding farewell to Lyca and Bryon, you travel through the night toward the Ashen Wastes...
narration:1:1760004001:0.female: After bidding farewell to Lyca and Bryon, you travel through the night toward the Ashen Wastes...

say:4:1760004002:0.text: Ugh, I can't stop sweating! I guess that's what the desert does to you...

say:5:1760004003:0.text: These people have long ears, tails, and claws too... Are they Wilders?
say:5:1760004003:0.source_cn: 周围有好多长着耳朵、尾巴和爪子的人……那些人也是绿裔吗？

choice_prompt:6:1760004003.text: These people have long ears, tails, and claws too... Are they Wilders?
choice_prompt:6:1760004003.source_cn: 周围有好多长着耳朵、尾巴和爪子的人……那些人也是绿裔吗？

say:7:1760004004:0.text: I see. How are we supposed to find Agumon in such a crowded place?
say:7:1760004004:0.source_cn: 原来是这样。但这里有这么多人，要想找到亚古兽恐怕会有些困难。

say:8:1760004005:0.text: Simple enough! Agumon came for the Trial of Courage, right? All we have to do is listen closely and approach those who know something about it.
say:8:1760004005:0.source_cn: 这个简单！亚古兽不是要参与勇气试炼吗？听听谁在谈论这个...

say:9:1760004006:0.text: I thought of that too, but practically everyone around us is talking about it.
say:9:1760004006:0.source_cn: 我试过了，没有用。周围所有人都在讨论试炼。

say:10:1760004007:0.text: I didn't realize that trial was such a big deal around here!
say:10:1760004007:0.source_cn: 亚古兽那家伙，原来要参加这么有名的试炼啊！

choice_prompt:11:1760004007.text: I didn't realize that trial was such a big deal around here!
choice_prompt:11:1760004007.source_cn: 亚古兽那家伙，原来要参加这么有名的试炼啊！

say:13:1760004009:0.text: He pulls out his monocular, quickly adjusts the focus, and scans the area...
say:13:1760004009:0.source_cn: 太一拿出随身携带的单筒望远镜，娴熟地调整焦距，开始在人...

say:14:1760004010:0.text: There's a huge crowd over there! Follow me!
say:14:1760004010:0.source_cn: 那边聚集了好多人，快跟我来！
say:14:1760004010:0.male: There's a huge crowd over there! Follow me!
say:14:1760004010:0.female: There's a huge crowd over there! Follow me!

narration:16:1760004011:0.text: You follow him, pushing your way through the crowd to the center.
narration:16:1760004011:0.source_cn: 跟着太一，你们一头扎入了热闹的人群
narration:16:1760004011:0.male: You follow him, pushing your way through the crowd to the center.
narration:16:1760004011:0.female: You follow him, pushing your way through the crowd to the center.

narration:17:1760004012:0.text: Amid the clamor, Taichi catches a familiar voice...
narration:17:1760004012:0.source_cn: 隔着吆喝、叫好、怒吼声，太一辨识出了一个熟悉的声音……

say:19:1760004013:0.text: Mmm... these chicken skewers taste heavenly!
say:19:1760004013:0.source_cn: 唔，唔……这个烤肉好好吃！这个也好好吃！

say:21:1760004014:0.text: Eat as much as you want! After you pass the trial, don't forget to tell everyone that Howling Skewers is your favorite!
say:21:1760004014:0.source_cn: 好吃吧？好吃就多吃点！等通过了勇气试炼，别忘了帮我宣传...

say:24:1760004015:0.text: Don't get your hopes up. There's no telling whether Agumon will pass the trial.
say:24:1760004015:0.source_cn: 我说老板，你考虑得也太远了吧？这个叫亚古兽的小家伙还不...

say:26:1760004016:0.text: I think Agumon has what it takes! Have you seen his fierce flames?
say:26:1760004016:0.source_cn: 我觉得亚古兽能行！瞧他那杀伤力极强的火焰！

say:27:1760004017:0.text: Agumon has the potential to be the next Kruger, or even Brutus!
say:27:1760004017:0.source_cn: 说不定，亚古兽就是下一个克鲁格——甚至是下一个布鲁特斯！

say:28:1760004018:1.text: Agumon, would you like to join our clan? You can represent us in the next Warsong Festival!
say:28:1760004018:1.source_cn: 亚古兽，要不要加入我们氏族？如果你足够强，就代表我们参...

say:32:1760004020:0.text: You've never heard of it? Guess you're not from around here. That explains a lot…
say:32:1760004020:0.source_cn: 你不知道战歌节吗？看来你并不来自荒角沙漠。不过，这就能...

say:33:1760004021:0.text: How can someone of your size eat that much? Is your digestive system built differently?
say:33:1760004021:0.source_cn: 你是怎么以这么小的体型，吃下这么多食物的？你的消化效率...

say:36:1760004022:0.text: Hey, it's my turn to ask a question! What made you decide to take on this trial, little one?
say:36:1760004022:0.source_cn: 轮到我问问题了！小家伙，你是怎么想到要参加勇气试炼的？

say:37:1760004023:0.text: The host, Mikola, said I'd be granted a wish if I pass the trial...
say:37:1760004023:0.source_cn: 因为，那个叫曼卡拉的主持人说，只要能通过试炼，就能许一...

say:38:1760004024:0.text: That's my only hope to find Taichi!

narration:47:1760004027:0.text: Agumon jumps in excitement. He dashes through the crowd and throws himself at Taichi...
narration:47:1760004027:0.source_cn: 亚古兽激动地跳了起来，飞快地穿过人群，与赶来的太一紧紧...

say:49:1760004028:0.text: Taichi, Taichi! Finally, here you are! I knew you'd come for me!
say:49:1760004028:0.source_cn: 太一，太一！太好了，终于找到你了！我就知道，一定能等到...

say:51:1760004029:0.text: Agumon, I heard everything. I know you took on this trial to find me, and I really appreciate that...
say:51:1760004029:0.source_cn: 亚古兽！我都听到了。谢谢你愿意为了找我参加试炼……

say:52:1760004030:0.text: Once the excitement of their reunion settles, Taichi fills Agumon in on how they ended up in Esperia, and how Gabumon is still missing...
say:52:1760004030:0.source_cn: 平复下重逢带来的激动后，太一将前因后果告诉了亚古兽。意...

say:53:1760004031:0.text: What Agumon said gave me an idea! I think I know how we can find Gabumon!
say:53:1760004031:0.source_cn: 不过，刚刚听亚古兽说完后，我想到了一个能找到加布兽的方法！

say:56:1760004033:0.text: The trial grants the winner a wish, right? If we pass it, we can ask everyone to help us find Gabumon!
say:56:1760004033:0.source_cn: 是勇气试炼！只要通过明天的试炼，就能实现一个愿望。到时...

say:57:1760004034:0.text: That's brilliant, Taichi! I'll do my best!
say:57:1760004034:0.source_cn: 太一最棒了，真是个好主意！我一定会努力的！

say:59:1760004036:0.text: No worries! That's what friends are for!

say:60:1760004037:0.text: And I'm sure we can pull this off! When Agumon's with me, I'm not afraid of anything!
say:60:1760004037:0.source_cn: 而且，我有成功的信心。只要我和亚古兽在一起，我就什么都不怕！
